hook_line: ADANI ENERGY WINS 25-YEAR BENGAL DEAL FOR 1,750 MW OF ROUND-THE-CLOCK RENEWABLE POWER

hook_stat.sub: Round-the-clock renewable power Adani Energy Solutions' subsidiary will supply to West Bengal's state discom for 25 years

stats.label: Term of the Letter of Award from WBSEDCL, West Bengal's state electricity distributor
Total capacity if WBSEDCL exercises the 750 MW greenshoe option on top of the award
When supply of the first 1,750 MW is scheduled to begin

diaspora_bullets: No tariff or contract value was disclosed, so the revenue the deal will generate cannot be calculated from the announcement
Nothing in the award changes West Bengal's power supply before the July 2028 start date
news_summary: Adani Energy Solutions said on Saturday, November 21, that its wholly owned subsidiary Powerpulse Trading Solutions Ltd has received a Letter of Award from West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Company Ltd (WBSEDCL) to supply 1,750 MW of renewable energy round-the-clock power for 25 years.
payoff: The confirmed facts are the 1,750 MW award, the 25-year term, and a start date in mid-2028 — how large the deal becomes depends on whether WBSEDCL exercises the 750 MW greenshoe option.
